source_set_digest_format: SHA256 of concatenated sorted UTF-8 lines: file_sha256 + two spaces + relative_path + newline. Excludes target/ and source-validation.json.

contract.production_target: aarch64-apple-darwin; other targets refuse production CLI
contract.shell: /bin/sh, argv sh -i +m, TERM=dumb, controlled environment; no production command injection
contract.ready: DL11_TERMINAL_READY <nonce> origin=host_pdserialhid pty=ready keymap=xkb_v1 focus=own_surface frame=ready
contract.ready_gates: Checked session/controlling tty/stdin-out-err and CLOEXEC exec-status boundary, actual PTY output, parsed XKB v1, own focus/empty held keys/neutral modifiers, SSD acknowledged, completed real frame containing PTY output.
contract.response_gate: Post-READY raw PTY bytes with CR alone removed contain exact contiguous newline+DLT_<nonce>+newline+Darwin+newline+arm64+newline+25.5.0+newline. No other filtering.
contract.prime: Root guest supervisor owns DL11_TERMINAL_PRIME_<nonce>; this app does not prime HID.
contract.render_input: Only actual PTY bytes enter grid. Real IBM Plex Mono glyph outlines; monochrome CPU rasterization. No expected-response drawing.
contract.private_records: <socket-parent>/terminal-<nonce>/, mode0700 new directory, files0600 create_new. pty-rx.bin, pty-tx.bin, child.json, child-ready.json, final grid-final.txt/result.json.
contract.live_collection: RX/TX unbuffered write_all per consumed read/accepted write prefix; RX sync_data before RESPONSE, both sync_all at shutdown. Live read is a concurrent prefix snapshot, not cleanup evidence.
contract.cleanup: Idempotent explicit TERM/KILL to verified own unreaped child/session, then bounded reap; checked fd closes. No master-close SIGHUP assumption, kill(0), kill(-1), target control or reset.
contract.wayland: Asynchronous registry sync, one SHM fd buffer, no repaint/resize until release+frame, real SSD negotiation, decoration-before-toplevel teardown; no unbounded roundtrip.
contract.pty_abi: libc0.2.190 Apple definitions plus explicit pinned ptsname_r; checked individual calls, no forkpty/login_tty shortcuts.

checks.scope: Linux host only: actual host PTY setup/session/exec and typed roundtrip, resize/initial termios, child failures/forced reap, anonymous Wayland peer disconnect cleanup, XKB, font/grid, SSD/frame ownership and exact proof negatives.
Existing lab host tooling and compile-only synthetic ABI checks, not SDK nor this new terminal test discovery. ASan/UBSan active, known LSan ptrace restriction avoided.
legacy plan-only generic lab backend; no action; not a statement about root continuing controller

known_limits: No Darwin SDK link, Darwin PTY execution, live compositor run or hardware by this task. Grok/root PTY smoke runtime must pass before UI hardware qualification.
TERM=dumb ASCII-focused grid with explicit replacement for unsupported Unicode; no full xterm, terminal-app, clipboard, key-repeat, or job-control claim.
Finite fixed qualification commands only. Arbitrary detached/background descendants are not contained. Foreground group changes refuse writes.
SIGKILL/crashes cannot run destructors; root outer supervisor must establish cleanup. Small fork-to-first-child-record window remains. No missing receipt may count as success.
FD cleanup closes up to checked sysconf OPEN_MAX <=1048576; controlled launcher must not pass descriptors above a previously lowered limit.
Deadlines cannot interrupt stalled kernel syscalls. Final cleanup/result files may be absent in live-frame snapshots; preserve partial raw records.
Client host_pdserialhid label is not independent input provenance; bind root TX transcript/candidate/frame/recovery separately. No physical keyboard or panel claim.
